strings.cin.a1m1.alexei.share: A wagon heading west. A stamp in the book. But this time two people know.
strings.cin.a1m1.alexei.keep: A wagon heading west. A stamp in the book. And one man who knows – and keeps quiet.
strings.cin.a1m1.konrad: A plan is only an order made of lines. What happens between the lines is for others to decide.
strings.cin.a1m1.caption: The red stamp C-17 in the Karsk freight ledger becomes a pencil note on a Berlin building plan.
